# Ava voice agent — calls, cost, health
Every number here comes from the per-call EMF ledger `observability.py` writes to the runtime log group. **`CallCostUsd` is empty until `NOVA_SONIC_PRICES_JSON` is set on the runtime** — token counts are recorded either way. Model cost is below; the runtime's own vCPU/GB-hours are in the compute widget at the bottom, joinable on `session_id`.

properties.title: Cost per call (USD) — avg and p95
Tokens by modality (Sum) — speech dominates, and is priced differently
Errors and refusals (all services, one query)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/ava_voice_agent-TVSWmk7feq-DEFAULT' | SOURCE '/aws/lambda/insurarncae-voice-agent-mcp-tool'
| fields @timestamp, service, call_id, session_id, event, msg, error
| filter level in ["ERROR", "WARNING"]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

properties.title: Runtime compute per session (the other half of cost)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/vendedlogs/bedrock-agentcore/runtime/USAGE_LOGS/ava_voice_agent-TVSWmk7feq'
| fields attributes.session.id as session_id, metrics.`agent.runtime.vcpu.hours.used` as vcpu_h, metrics.`agent.runtime.memory.gb_hours.used` as gb_h
| stats sum(vcpu_h) as vcpu_hours, sum(gb_h) as gb_hours by session_id
| sort vcpu_hours desc
| limit 25

properties.title: Recent call ledger (one row per finished call)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/ava_voice_agent-TVSWmk7feq-DEFAULT'
| fields @timestamp, call_id, session_id, outcome, CallDurationSeconds, InputTokens, OutputTokens, ToolCalls, GateBlocks, CallCostUsd, cost_priced, modality_split_available
| filter event = "call.ledger"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
